title: Deer reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <!-- deer chest lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#E8A86A'/>
  <!-- deer head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='16' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='11' fill='#E8A86A'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='32' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(-20 36 32)' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='33' rx='3' ry='6' transform='rotate(-20 36 33)' fill='#F0C8A0'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='32' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(20 64 32)' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='33' rx='3' ry='6' transform='rotate(20 64 33)' fill='#F0C8A0'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M42 30 L38 18 L34 22 M38 18 L36 14' stroke='#B8860B' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 30 L62 18 L66 22 M62 18 L64 14' stroke='#B8860B' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='3' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='44' r='3' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='43' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 55 Q50 59 54 55' stroke='#5C3A1E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <path d='M30 68 Q35 62 42 65' stroke='#C97A3D' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 68 Q65 62 58 65' stroke='#C97A3D' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='36' y='62' width='28' height='18' rx='2' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='62' width='4' height='18' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='38' y='64' width='10' height='14' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <rect x='52' y='64' width='10' height='14' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- book lines -->
  <line x1='40' y1='68' x2='46' y2='68' stroke='#C0A080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='71' x2='46' y2='71' stroke='#C0A080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='74' x2='45' y2='74' stroke='#C0A080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='68' x2='60' y2='68' stroke='#C0A080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='71' x2='60' y2='71' stroke='#C0A080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='74' x2='59' y2='74' stroke='#C0A080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
</svg>
